hints.title: Horner Rule Base 26 Evaluation
hints.text: Converting the column string to a number is polynomial evaluation in base 26 where character values range from one for A to twenty-six for Z.

hints.title: Accumulator Multiplication Invariant
hints.text: Processing characters from left to right, multiplying the running total by twenty-six and adding the current character value accumulates the decimal value.

hints.title: Sequential Decimal Conversion Procedure
hints.text: Initialize accumulator to zero. Iterate through each character in the column string from left to right. Multiply accumulator by twenty-six and add character code minus 64. Return accumulator.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Computing powers of 26 independently for each position takes extra power operations and risks precision errors.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Horner rule processes characters in a single linear pass in O(N) time and requires strictly O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should provide the simple left-to-right Horner rule accumulation and recognize base-26 character offset.
